signal: Solutionreach marked its 25th anniversary in July 2025, having facilitated more than 15 billion patient messages, and is expanding across dental, optometry and dermatology specialties.

email.body1:
Danielle, saw Solutionreach just marked 25 years and 15 billion patient messages across specialties.

Expanding into more specialties usually means more in-market practices than an SMB sales team can cover before interest fades, and that is where deals slip. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Solutionreach off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Danielle, quick follow-up for Solutionreach.

In SMB, volume is everything, and reps burn time on research and CRM instead of the practices ready to buy, so the best-fit accounts get a generic touch. Tightening emails to 75-100 words alone tends to lift responses about 67%, and most teams never hit that at scale.

I had our AI SDR draft 3 personalized emails to your top 3 target accounts. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through them?
email.body3:
Danielle, last bit of proof for Solutionreach.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Solutionreach's reply rate likely compares to other healthcare SaaS teams. Want to grab time so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Danielle, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling SMB pipeline without adding reps isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Expanding into new specialties is its own kind of busy, and I know timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your SMB motion? I'll tailor it to Solutionreach either way.
